title: About Jude Hill — Web Designer & Developer in Eugene, Oregon
description: About Jude Hill — a web designer and developer in Eugene, Oregon who designs in the browser, ships every few days, and hands off sites you can update yourself.

blocks.headline: Hi, I'm Jude Hill.
blocks.subheadline: I'm a high school student from Eugene, Oregon who builds stunning websites that are fast and simple. Whether you're a small business, a creative, or just someone with an idea — I'd love to help you create something you'll love.
blocks.photoAlt: Jude sitting on a slackline in the woods

blocks.title: Outside the browser
blocks.text: FPV drones, an Etsy store, and a workshop full of half-finished projects. Same hands, same care that goes into your website.
